courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 新河峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」與「1932 年機車載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；新河峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" and "The 1932 locomotive load test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of New River Gorge Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港；新河峽大橋則以以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets; New River Gorge Bridge centres on spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙鉸拱支承」與「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到新河峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「線形量測與溫度修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-hinged arch bearings” and “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to New River Gorge Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry surveys and temperature correction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
history.text: 跨越雪梨港的構想可追溯到 19 世紀，新南威爾斯公共工程部總工程師 J. J. C. Bradfield 長期推動，1922 年通過大橋法案。1924 年國際招標由英國 Dorman Long 公司以拱橋方案得標，其顧問工程師 Ralph Freeman 負責細部設計與架設；1923 年開始引道工程，1928 年開始架設鋼拱，1930 年 8 月兩半拱合龍，1932 年初以 96 輛機車做載重試驗，3 月 19 日通車。其工程意義在於以 U 形岩盤隧道錨碇鋼索懸臂架設當時世界級跨度的鋼拱、同時承載公路與鐵路，以及延續至今的大規模維護管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: A harbour crossing was proposed from the nineteenth century, and J. J. C. Bradfield, chief engineer of the New South Wales Public Works Department, championed it for years until the Sydney Harbour Bridge Act passed in 1922. An international tender in 1924 was won by the British firm Dorman Long with an arch design, its consulting engineer Ralph Freeman leading detailed design and erection; approach works began in 1923, arch erection in 1928, the half-arches met in August 1930, a load test with 96 locomotives followed in early 1932, and the bridge opened on 19 March 1932. Its significance lies in cantilevering a steel arch of world-class span with cables anchored in U-shaped rock tunnels, carrying road and rail together, and a large-scale maintenance regime that continues today. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
